item.title: Atelier 1.0.0
item.description:
The first copy of Atelier to share as a file. It now keeps itself up to date.
### New - **Atelier > Check for Updates…** looks for a new version on Atelier’s GitHub releases. Atelier also checks once a day by itself. - **Settings > Updates:** your version, when Atelier last checked, and whether updates download and install by themselves when you quit. Include beta versions if you want previews of the next release. - **What’s New in Atelier** opens once after each update with what changed, and any time from Help > What’s New in Atelier. - **Catalog backups before upgrades:** when a new version needs to upgrade your catalog, Atelier first saves a copy in the catalog’s Backups > Before Upgrade folder.
